svg.title: Core flow: record a reading to seeing the report

g.text: Core flow: record a reading to seeing the report
Open HealthGuard and sign in with email + password
Review trends, set reminders, share selected data or download the report
Show "Select Your Language / अपनी भाषा चुनें"
Switch entire UI (EN / हिं) and save the preference
Enter reading (BP / SpO2 / HR / glucose / temperature / weight) with date-time and notes
Show the field error in the active language
Refresh the dashboard cards with normal / warning / critical colours
Update the notification bell badge and the alerts page
Render the trend chart for 7 / 30 / custom range
Show the disclaimer "This is not medical advice. Consult a qualified doctor."
input valid for the parameter range?
Create reading with a parameterised SQL statement
AlertEngine.findTrendAlerts() - rising trend or 3 abnormal days
Build a cautious bilingual message - never a diagnosis
